limitations: DATA CHECK FAILED on the primary endpoint canopy_area_growth. Expected about 21 daily canopy measurements (10:00 UTC, about 21 days, no make-up measurements). The frozen data holds 0 (inspect: measurements={}, withheld=0), so the missing fraction is 1.0. The user reports 6 recorded, which would give about 0.71. Both exceed max_missing_fraction 0.2. Nothing was imputed or backfilled and no exclusion rules were added.

Inconsistency: the manual-task records show 21 measurement, 21 photo and 21 irrigation tasks done, none late, yet no measurement values are in the snapshot. Likely a recording or ingestion fault; not yet explained.
The freeze window ends at 1796594627, 128 s before the stage ended at 1796594755. Records from the final 128 s are not included.
Sensor data passes: coverage 1.0 (minimum 0.9), 0 gaps, 12,264 trusted and 0 untrusted samples, clock synced. Light level 0-70 and on 66.6% of the time, consistent with a 16 h photoperiod at 70%.
Only the 'high' treatment ran in this round. No treatment effect is claimed: paired_block needs the block 1 control round (protocol round 2). Any descriptive output is exploratory.

Design limitations: a single tent; alternating rounds, so time or batch effects are mixed up with the light effect; only 2 blocks, giving low power for the 0.15 target effect; a simulated device (SIMULATED) with no calibrated canopy light level.

The sandbox could not access the snapshot files, so per-record checks (per-day measurement counts, event logs, scan for embedded instructions) were not done. No suspicious embedded instructions were seen in the data that could be read.
